one_liner: Shopify offers a broad GraphQL (plus legacy REST) Admin API with self-serve OAuth apps and free dev stores; ready to build, though an official dev-docs MCP exists but no store-operating MCP.
auth_notes: Authorization code grant, token exchange and client credentials are supported for apps. Admin-created custom apps give a static shpat_ token. Public apps use the OAuth authorization-code flow. Tokens are sent in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header.
access_notes: A free Partner account provides free development stores for sandbox testing. API access has no extra charge. Some scopes need Shopify approval, such as protected customer data and payments scopes.
blocker_notes: Some scopes and customer data fields need Shopify approval, but core development and testing are unblocked.

evidence.quote: Authorization Code Grant Flow - Suitable for non-embedded apps - Installations, and access scope changes are managed by the app
Copy the **Admin API access token** shown once after installation
Next, create a **development store**. It’s free and sandboxed. You can test API calls without touching real orders or customer data.
Shopify does not charge extra for API usage. However, API rate limits apply (REST and GraphQL), and the limits vary by the store’s Shopify plan.

Most Shopify APIs, including the [GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql), [Storefront API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront), and [Partner API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/partner)
Run the following command to start the Shopify dev MCP server: npx -y @shopify/dev-mcp@latest
